newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK foreign reserves US$63.8 bln at end Feb - HKMA.
newsitem.headline: HK foreign reserves US$63.8 bln at end Feb - HKMA.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said on Thursday the amount of foreign reserves held in the Exchange Fund stood at US$63.8 billion at the end of February.
That represents a drop from the US$65.9 billion, excluding unsettled forward transactions, recorded at the end of January, the HKMA said. The decline was due to seasonal factors, it said.
Hong Kong's foreign reserves were the seventh largest in world, it added.
